technical.summary: Strong structural bullish setup with Ichimoku cross and price above all MAs, but extreme RSI overbought conditions and weakening short-term momentum create elevated pullback risk; better suited for scaling into weakness than aggressive entry.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (281), rising dollar, and imminent FOMC decision creates severe risk environment for financials despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cloud cross-up with price above all major moving averages provides structural bullish confirmation in a fear-driven market (VIX 39 equivalent) offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (91.04), weakening momentum (RSI_9 and OBV both falling), crisis macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 281, FOMC imminent), and zero fundamental conviction create exhaustion risk with limited upside room to resistance at 113.14.
